<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2516-1">
     <milestone unit="section" n="1. mdo' sbyar ba la 'jug pa (1b7–1b9)"/>
     <milestone unit="section" n="12"/><note type="gloss">gang zag 3 po de dag gang las byung zhe na yon tan gnyis bshad do || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa</rs>'i zhal nas go mi chen po gsung skad nas mkhyen pa 3 gi dbye ba <expan>la sogs</expan> pa <choice><reg>rnaMs</reg><orig>°s</orig></choice> 'dir 'chad phyis 'og du <expan>skabs su</expan> bab gsung nas | lus phung 'chad zhes</note> 
     nyan pa po skal ldan spyan drang ba ni <quote>rgyal sras gang dag</quote> nas te | <note type="gloss">rgyal sras gang dag khyad par gyi gzhi'o | skye bo nas khyad par te | gzhan don phyir yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'o | dgra dang skal bas ma phaM ma rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi gdung <note type="gloss">mtshan ldan gdung 'tshob pas <expan>sras brjod</expan> pa bzhin</note> 'tshob pa'i sras las <expan>nyan thos</expan> kyi dbang gis skye ba'i skye ba po yin pas skye bo ma lus ma smin pa smin pa mi 'dun pa 'dun pa ma grol ba grol bar 2 las tha ma bzung ba bsgral phyir ro | byang chub ni byang chub chen po'o |</note> 'gro ba mtha' dag drang ba'i ched du byang chub dam pa don du gnyer <note type="gloss">ba dor na <expan>sems bskyed</expan> pa'i</note> ba'i blo ldan rnams <note type="gloss">gang yin pa zhes bsnyegs so</note> <note>slob dpon la ma ltos par</note> <note type="gloss">mthong lam du</note> dang | rang nyid byang chub gyi sgo mngon par rtogs nas <note type="gloss">rang rgyal 'phags par 'gyur ba gang dag sangs rgyas pas dman nyan thos pas mchog pas de dag dang mnyam myed</note> slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam de nyid mthar 'phyin par byed pa 'am | rang gi byang chub thob nas slar <note type="gloss">'o na gtan du ba'i zhe na mthar thug gtan du ba myed pas</note> yang lam dam par 'jug par byed pa rang rgyal rnams <note type="gloss"/>gang yin ces dang | <note type="gloss">thub pas gsungs pa'i rjes su 'jug gi rang gi shes rab kyi</note> mi slob pa dang slob pa'i lam <lb n="1b9"/> kyis 'bras bu nyon mong pa dang phug bsngal gnon cing 'dor bas 'gro gnyan thos rnams te | lam gsum la gnas pa rigs can gsum po yum nyan pa <expan>la sogs</expan> pa'i skal ldan de dag <expan>thams cad</expan> chos gyi sbyin pa la rtse gcig pa'i spro <note type="gloss">dag °°°° dang bcas bas</note> bas 'du bar spyan drang ba'o ||</seg></TEI>
